description: Shared, implementation-neutral conformance vectors for DSH permission gates that consume the dsh-permission-rules rule syntax. Every vector carries its own rule text and the expected first-match decision for each case; gates that claim this syntax evaluate the same inputs to the same outputs. The reference implementation is dsh-permission-rules (see docs/rule-test-vectors/README.md).

vectors.purpose: an exact tool-name match denies; other tools pass through
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match: { tools: [bash] }
    action: deny
    reason: shell is denied

vectors.purpose: tool-name globs match whole names (mcp__*); non-matching tools pass through
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match: { tools: ["mcp__*"] }
    action: ask
    reason: mcp tools need approval

vectors.purpose: a params pattern matched against the command string denies the destructive call only
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match:
      tools: [bash, pwsh]
      params:
        command: ["rm -rf*", "git push*--force*"]
    action: deny
    reason: destructive command

vectors.purpose: a negation-only pattern matches a present value that hits no negation
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match:
      tools: [bash]
      params:
        command: ["!*test*"]
    action: deny
    reason: test commands are blocked

vectors.purpose: workspace-relative path patterns deny secret files; unrelated paths pass
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match:
      paths: ["**/.env", "**/secrets/**", "**/*.pem"]
    action: deny
    reason: protected secrets and credential paths are off-limits

vectors.purpose: a when.platform condition matches only the named platform
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match:
      tools: [bash]
      when: { platform: [win32] }
    action: deny
    reason: shell denied on windows

vectors.purpose: a when.env condition matches only when the variable is present with a matching value
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match:
      tools: [bash]
      when:
        env: { CI: "true" }
    action: deny
    reason: no shell inside CI

vectors.purpose: an agents-scoped rule fires only for the matching identity candidate and fails closed for unknown identity
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match:
      tools: [bash]
      agents: [subagent]
    action: deny
    reason: subagents cannot run the shell

vectors.purpose: an absent dimension fires when the listed keys are missing
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match:
      tools: [write]
      absent: [dryRun]
    action: deny
    reason: write requires an explicit dryRun guard

vectors.purpose: rules evaluate in written order; the first match settles the decision
vectors.rules:
rules:
  - match: { tools: [bash] }
    action: allow
    reason: shell is allowed first
  - match: { tools: [bash] }
    action: deny
    reason: unreachable for bash

rules:
  - match: { tools: [bash] }
    action: deny
    reason: currently disabled
    enabled: false
